title: Reading chess moves
intro: Every square has a name, and every move can be written in a few letters. Learn to read them, and the lessons, books and videos open up.

lessons.title: Names of the squares
lessons.summary: A letter for the column, a number for the row.

steps.text: Every square has a name: a letter for its column, from a to h, then a number for its row, from 1 to 8. White's pieces start on rows 1 and 2.
This square is e4: column e, row 4. Find the column first, then count up the rows.

steps.ifWrong: f3 is column f, row 3, just in front of the f-pawn.

steps.hint: The pawn on column d can go two squares, up to row 4.
steps.ifWrong: d4 is column d, row 4: the d-pawn goes two squares.

steps.hint: Column c, row 3. Which knight can reach it?
steps.ifWrong: c3 is column c, row 3. The knight on b1 can jump there.

lessons.title: Writing moves down
lessons.summary: The piece's letter, then where it goes.

steps.text: A move is written as the piece's letter and the square it goes to. K is the king, Q the queen, R a rook, B a bishop and N a knight. Pawns have no letter.
Play Nf3: N is a knight, f3 is where it goes.
steps.hint: N is the knight. Which knight can reach f3?
steps.ifWrong: Nf3 means the knight goes to f3.

steps.text: Play e4. There is no letter, so it is a pawn.
steps.ifWrong: No letter means a pawn. Move the pawn to e4.

steps.text: An x means a capture. exd5 is the pawn from column e taking on d5.

steps.hint: The pawn on column e takes on d5.
steps.ifWrong: exd5: the e-pawn takes the pawn on d5.

steps.text: Moves are numbered. 1.e4 is White's first move, and 1...e5, with three dots, is Black's answer to it.
A + after a move means check, and # means checkmate. O-O is castling on the king's side, and O-O-O on the queen's side.

steps.hint: Castle on the king's side: the king moves two squares towards the rook.
steps.ifWrong: O-O is castling on the king's side.
steps.ifRight: O-O: castling. Your king is safe.

steps.hint: Q is the queen, x is a capture, f7 is the square, # is checkmate.
steps.ifWrong: Qxf7#: the queen takes on f7, and it is checkmate.
steps.ifRight: Qxf7#: queen takes on f7, checkmate. Now you can read any move.
